title: ficus subpuberula
intro: Ficus subpuberula, commonly known as the dwarf fig, is a species of fig that belongs to the family Moraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief for various health issues such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ficus subpuberula include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in Ficus subpuberula include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
